_: The site's themes: what a page is painted in, on every page and under every look. One entry per theme; each but classic has src/themes/<id>.css, loaded on demand by src/look-boot.js and swapped by src/looks.js, which overrides the palette variables styles.css paints from (html[data-theme=<id>] { --ink: ...; --accent: ...; }) and may add a flourish. swatch is five colours for the picker's card: the page, a panel, the accent, the good colour, the text. The page's default is data-theme-default on <html>. Add a theme = a file + an entry; replace one = swap its file, keep its id. A theme paints; a look (src/looks/) shapes.
